title: Planet Tweaks V2.3.8 ULTRA — Dedicated Tab Reorder Organizer & Customize Mode
releaseNotes: Dedicated Customize Mode & Tab Organizer: Added glowing '📐 Customize' button at the top of the sidebar, in Settings Section 2, and in Deleted Tabs to easily move tabs ▲ Up and ▼ Down to reorder your sidebar hierarchy. Interactive Tab Management: Instantly reorder, hide, or restore any tab with realtime position badges (#1, #2, #3...) and one-click Reset Default Order. Expandable Patch Notes: Added dedicated dropdown viewer in Settings and top banner to easily read full release details without crowding. Double Right-Click Quick Hide: Fast power-user shortcut to hide tabs into the Deleted Tabs Vault. Auto-Relaunch on Update: Planet Tweaks automatically relaunches in the foreground when updates complete.
